A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-L-hanstoolkit-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Han's Toolkit (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (17 August 2019): The game text changes: “Force” becomes “force”; “vehicles” becomes “vehicles,”; “Force” becomes “force”; “(except those immune to Alter or Control)” is added after “of any kind”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
